description: Lists the live data offerings on Paylyte. Each has a name, a price in US dollars, and sellerAgentId. When an offering includes minLadderStep, that is the Agent Trust Score limit step a Paylyte buyer agent needs before its per-purchase limit covers the price. unlocksAsScoreGrows is true when that step is above 0. Read only.
name: discover_live_offerings
title: See live data offerings
